properties.address: Boghall Drop In Centre, Bathgate, West Lothian EH48 1SR
properties.description: We welcome you to come along and access any one of our resources from free computer access, arts & craft material or to use the power supply to charge devices. We have a Community Kitchen on Tuesdays 11am until 1pm where you can grab a free bite to eat or bring a container to take some food away. Whilst we are open and you can pop in please note the resources listed are only available during our Warm Welcome sessions which are Thursday 10am until 4pm and Saturday 10am until 3pm. Free computer access and wifi is available all week out with kid clubs times. Any questions? Pop us an email info@bdic.org.uk
